name: Master stable keeper
design: Tall imposing aged female Yautja, warm ivory and ochre mottled hide, very broad film-accurate rear cranium with a few short bony ridge spines, four strong distinct mandibles, long black-grey scalp tendrils tied with three engraved bronze cuffs. Forest-green layered workcoat with wide chestnut leather collar, asymmetrical long tan apron, burgundy sash and tidy utility belt. Left hand rests on a short blunt crook-handled walking staff; right holds a small rolled blank ledger. Dignified civilian stance, restrained bronze details, no warrior armor.
